name: bjsonvalue-test-248ac7be19/null-json-to-string-p.bal
reason: The case uses a nil literal assigned to json, a cast to string, local declarations, returns and ordinary function calls, all within the supported constructs. The @panic asserts the runtime TypeCastError for casting nil to string, including its incompatible-types message; this is the failure behavior of the supported type cast. No restricted langlib operation is involved.
test_design_notes: The @panic is attached to the cast reached through main; there are no @args or @output assertions.
